title: Lecture → Pretraining LLMs: Loss Function
diagram_summary: Three-stage pipeline for building and pretraining LLMs: Stage 1 covers data preparation, attention mechanism, and LLM architecture leading to building an LLM; Stage 2 involves pretraining the LLM model with training loop and model evaluation metrics to create a foundation model; Stage 3 loads pretrained weights and performs finetuning on downstream tasks (classifier, personal assistant) using labeled datasets and instruction datasets.
